about: The ships sounds: 48 kHz 16-bit mono WAVs, every file's peak at -1 dBFS. Play a sound at its "gain" (multiply) so the set is levelled against itself: swings under hits, hits under heavy hits, the finishing blow the loudest. Pick one of the files at random each time. loud_db: the loudest 50 ms of the file before the gain; target_db: where it should sit (the sword's hit = about 0).

oar_a.use: one man's oar stroke, slow (raw); every 1.2 to 1.6 s while rowing: well under a blow
oar_a.anchor: hit_1.wav at gain 0.417; target -8 dB relative to it

oar_b.anchor: hit_1.wav at gain 0.417; target -8 dB relative to it

oars_v.anchor: hit_1.wav at gain 0.417; target -5 dB relative to it

sail_fill_a.use: the sail catching the wind as it is set (raw flag snaps); once
sail_fill_a.anchor: hit_1.wav at gain 0.417; target -4 dB relative to it

sail_fill_v.use: the sail catching the wind (the studio's, with weight)
sail_fill_v.anchor: hit_1.wav at gain 0.417; target -4 dB relative to it

sail_flap_a.use: the sail luffing (raw, longer); may repeat every second or two: quiet
sail_flap_a.anchor: hit_1.wav at gain 0.417; target -12 dB relative to it

sail_flap_b.anchor: hit_1.wav at gain 0.417; target -12 dB relative to it

creak_a.use: the hull creaking at sea (Kenney's creaks at half speed); now and then
creak_a.anchor: hit_1.wav at gain 0.417; target -10 dB relative to it

creak_b.use: the hull and rigging creaking (the tree creak and a wood squeak, slowed)
creak_b.anchor: hit_1.wav at gain 0.417; target -10 dB relative to it

creak_v.use: the hull and rigging creaking (the studio's: planks, rope, a knock)
creak_v.anchor: hit_1.wav at gain 0.417; target -10 dB relative to it

keel_sand_v.use: the keel running up onto sand, once on beaching (built from the studio's own material)
keel_sand_v.anchor: hit_1.wav at gain 0.417; target -3 dB relative to it

keel_off_v.use: pushing off the sand (built from the studio's own material)
keel_off_v.anchor: hit_1.wav at gain 0.417; target -5 dB relative to it
